cards.summary: 1.5% eligible Kiwi QR · 0.5% Kiwi online · standard plan
cards.headline: 1.5% eligible Kiwi scan & pay
cards.caveat: Standard plan only, for cards issued via Kiwi since 4 July 2024; no Neon or Boost. ₹0 joining and annual card fees. Rewards accrue per completed ₹100 on eligible Kiwi merchant payments; 4 Kiwis = ₹1. Redeem to a linked bank account in multiples of 500 Kiwis (₹125). The monthly cap FAQ describes 1% of credit limit in rupees, while the policy describes a cap in Kiwis; confirm your actual remaining allowance in rupees before ranking. Fuel, utilities and other excluded MCCs earn no regular Kiwi reward. Digital-only YES BANK card; no physical POS or peer payments. Optional Neon (₹999 + tax/year): 2% QR, 0.5% online, milestone top-ups to 3%/4%/5% at ₹50k/₹1L/₹1.5L eligible annual spend with one lounge visit at each milestone. Optional Boost (₹49 + tax/3 months, select users): 1% eligible online. Membership rewards, fees, lounges, issuer points and temporary offers are not included in this comparison.
